1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __embedded in the test tube at a specific location and orientation that differs from prior art teachings__.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through an optically transparent or translucent window formed in the bottom surface of the test tube__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the polymer is selected to maintain structural integrity and MTP readability at temperatures of -20°C or below__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; __an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes that is configured to read the embedded MTP during movement or storage__; and __an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes while maintaining the integrity of the embedded MTP__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 __wherein the system is adapted for low temperature operation such that the racks/test tubes are stored and handled at -20°C or less, and wherein the embedded MTP remains readable at such temperatures__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: __heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to create a permanent embedded bond that maintains MTP readability__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP __through the test tube material without removing or disturbing the MTP from its embedded position__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the polymer is selected to maintain structural integrity and MTP readability at cryogenic temperatures__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through an optically transparent or translucent window formed in the bottom surface of the test tube__.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through an optically transparent or translucent window formed in the bottom surface of the test tube__.
